answer: In a Proof of Agent network, nodes anchor cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs to a verifiable identity tree, requiring an exponential capital bond $C(k) = b \cdot 2^k$ for each concurrent sub-agent. Rogue agents cannot blindly wander into the consensus ocean; unbounded entity replication is pushed past an unreachable horizon.
